Disable the native 'donate items to increase rank' action on the Rift completion crafter - she has no persistent rank (spawned fresh each run with fixed attempts), so the button only confused players. Isolated re-test: this field previously failed to take effect alongside several LocaleStringId field patches that we now know don't reach the client at all (text-on-VendorType is client-resolved from its own local data) - testing this boolean action-flag on its own since it's a different kind of field (behavior, not display text) and vendor stock/behavior data has separately been confirmed to transmit correctly.

This recipe's native 75,000-credit CraftingCost is purely a client-side display value - the server never reads it (see TryHandleMythicRiftCompletionCraft() in Player.Crafting.cs, which intercepts this recipe entirely before the native cost-eval code is ever reached) and it was misleadingly showing 75,000 credits in the crafting UI when the real cost is 100 Champion's Commendations on a successful upgrade. Zeroed to the same CostEvalCredits=0 baseline every no-cost recipe in the game already uses (confirmed via Entity/Items/Crafting/ZAbstract/CraftingCost.defaults), so the UI shows no cost pill instead of a wrong one.
